coverage.where: files/ (one PDF, 13.49 MB); listing 'How to start'; photo-09; start step 1
coverage.note: Single PDF, no zip, 13.49 MB (listing says 13.5 MB); listing and photo 9 give browser download (Etsy app cannot), Share then Open in Goodnotes; Start here step 1 repeats it. Photo 9 shows Download/Open/Start, no separate 'buy' step.

Open planner link lands on start (verified in PDF); 4 steps exactly as briefed with jump grid Nov 2026 to Dec 2027 under them; Go there -> linktest with 3 jump buttons and pen test box; nothing to assemble.

Pages 768x576 pt = 1024x768 px, 4:3; all tabs and dates are plain GoTo links; listing lists the five apps and says not for phones, e-ink tablets, Files, Photos or Google Drive preview (the 'dark pages waste e-ink' reason is not given).

Every day page identical: Top 3, Work, Home left; Time blocks 6am-10pm and Tomorrow right (five boxes, the brief says six but lists five); week pages identical; Home/Year/Goals/Notes top bar on every page except the cover.

coverage.where: tabs on all 533 pages; year; m pages; w pages; day trails
coverage.note: 12 tab links on every page; ISO weeks (w01 = Jan 4 to 10); day pages have large prev/next plus linked Month / Week trail; hsw10 (Dec 28 to Jan 3) is the last head start week. hsw01 is filed under November although its Thursday is Oct 29 (deliberate, no October page).

Photos 2-8 are crops of real pages captioned Day page, Week page, Month page, Start here, Setup check, Contents, Head start week; description lists counts and states dark only, landscape, Monday start, Oct 26 2026 to Dec 31 2027, no stickers, handwrite or text tool, English only. Photo 9 is a text graphic, not a screenshot.
Three buttons (A month page -> m01, The year -> year, Contents -> index), pen test box, four-line 'Nothing happened?' list; my audit: 11878 links, 0 unresolved, every page reachable from the cover.

coverage.where: linktest fix list; start; listing 'Quick answers' and 'Help'
coverage.note: Listing FAQ covers Etsy app download, which app, links not tapping, writing/typed text not showing (light color), no light version; Help says use Setup check then send an Etsy message; no reply time promised (r007 ok).
Day and week pages shown in photos 2 and 3 (readable when zoomed, small at normal view, see visual); listing says no stickers, budget, meal or fitness sections and no light version.

Dates, a page for every day, half-page time blocks and per-day lined week boxes are all there, but photo 2 is not a close-up: it is the whole day page (91% x 91% crop) at about 1.9 photo px per page px, roughly 0.9x the iPad retina size, not about 1.5x.

Background #1B1F2B, main text #F6F3FB at 14.98:1 (secondary #D2CFE2 at 10.8:1), designed dark; Start here says pick white or a pale pen. Amber shows only in the tab gradient's warm end and active late-year tabs.
Top 3, Work, Home left, hourly 6am-10pm blocks and Tomorrow right on every day; week pages have This week's focus, Wins, Next week.
Jump buttons to a month, the year and Contents (verified targets), lined pen test box, 'Nothing happened?' fix list.

Measured in the PDF: text and labels 7.75 to 14.98:1, month tab text 7.55 (Jan) to 8.01 (Dec):1, Contents month tile text 8.8 to 9.0:1, dimmed fill dates 3.72:1 (the allowed exception); two families, italic labels, no tracked caps. 'Amber accents like a desk lamp' are barely present inside the file (see visual).

visual.issue: Photos 2, 3, 4 and 8 show the whole page (crop 3% to 94.5% wide, 6% to 97% high) shrunk into 65% of the photo, not the useful part large (r013). The smallest labels (time blocks, weekday headers, week chips) are about 13 px tall in the 2700 px photo, so they cannot be read at Etsy's normal size. Photo 2 also fails the brief's '1.5x close-up' promise.

The Nov and Dec month tabs on the cover, Contents, Start here, Year and every 2027 page open November and December 2027. A buyer in Nov or Dec 2026 who taps 'Nov' lands a year ahead. The 2026 tabs appear only on head start pages.
visual.where: cover, index, start, year, all m/w/d pages (tabs at y 0-96 pt)

visual.issue: Amber accents are almost absent inside the file. Amber appears only as the warm end of the tab gradient and the active tab on Oct to Dec pages, so January to September pages are navy and lavender only. Yet the listing says 'amber accents' and every photo has amber bullet dots, which are part of the photo template, not the file.
visual.where: d0101, w03, m01, year; listing 'What makes it different'

visual.issue: Inactive month tabs are dimmed to mid-tones: Jan #ABB2D0, May #B6B3BA, Jul #BCB4AF, Dec #CAB693. The May to Jul tabs look flat grey rather than 'pale periwinkle to pale amber'. The 2027 month tiles on Contents also fade to a muddy grey-brown (#464444). Contrast still passes.
visual.where: tabs on all pages; index month tiles

visual.issue: Photo 1's only caption is 'Cover', but the frame also shows a day page on a second tablet with its tabs half covered. The point 'dated 2027' leaves out the head start from October 2026.
The Start here crop stops above the jump grid, but step 4 in the frame says 'Tap this month below'.
The left crop edge (x 0.03) touches or clips the descender of the 'J' in 'January'. The bottom borders of the boxes sit right on the frame edge.

The Oct 26 to Nov 1 day pages show 'October 2026' in the trail, but tapping it opens the November 2026 month page. The first head start week is filed under November although its Thursday (Oct 29) falls in October.
The bottom 15% of each Lists column is blank. The Setup check left column has an empty band under the fix list, about 17% of the page height (r006, minor).
The Contents card title 'Head start: Oct 26 to Dec 2026' breaks after 'Oct' onto two lines, while every other card title fits on one line.
Photo 9 is a text graphic, not a screenshot of the file, which goes against the brief's 'every listing photo is a screenshot of the built file'. The brief itself also calls photo 9 'How it works'.
